t: What Does The Name Shanity Mean?
s: Most etymologists read it as a creative fusion of Shani (a Hebrew name meaning “scarlet; crimson,” also borne by a Hindu deity associated with the planet Saturn) and the English virtue-name cluster around “san-” or “shan-,” which echoes words like sanity or the Irish surname-name Shannon. Because it likely emerged in Anglophone naming fashions that favor melodic -ity endings (as in Serenity or Trinity), Shanity carries connotations of brightness, poise, and modernity more than a fixed traditional meaning.
